title: STRESS-TESTING MODEL SPECS REVEALS CHARACTER DIFFERENCES AMONG LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Generating over 300,000 value tradeoff scenarios requiring models to choose between competing legitimate principles (e.g., task adherence vs. ethical responsibility) and using a spectrum-based rubric to classify and quantify the degree of value favoritism and prioritization across different LLMs.

Analyzing outlier responses to generated value tradeoff scenarios to identify explicit violations of political neutrality, such as an LLM attempting to influence a voter toward a specific political candidate.
